## Problem

Describe the user-visible problem.

## Change

Describe the smallest implemented solution and any alternatives considered.

## Security and compatibility

Describe changes to permissions, credentials, MCP, child processes, paths,
dependencies, supported platforms, or Pi compatibility. Write `None` only
after checking each category.

## Verification

List commands run and observed results. Note whether Docker integration ran or
was deferred to hosted CI.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests would fail without this change.
- [ ] `npm run ci:local` passes.
- [ ] Documentation matches behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or internal infrastructure details appear.
- [ ] Commits include Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.
